name: Sasaki Ken
source: Despite being the sort of person who's words and facial expressions betray his thoughts, he is a very level-headed person. He comes from an ordinary middle-class family and has younger siblings. There's a girl from another school that he's been interested in recently, but he doesn't want her to see him cross-dressing.
